AI-Reinforced SIEM Platform for Advanced Cybersecurity Operations
Transform your Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) with our 5x Gartner MQ Leading SIEM Platform, enhanced with AI-powered capabilities. Elevate your security operations with our integrated SIEM and SOAR solution, and discover a security analytics platform that scales with your needs.
Book a Demo
Download Datasheet
Scale up your Threat Defense
Proactive threat defense with the industry’s first combination of AI, Cybersecurity Mesh, and a Frictionless Experience, our best-in-class SIEM unifies threat detection, investigation, and response (TDIR) on Snowflake’s Data Cloud.
Request a Demo
Why Choose the Securonix SIEM Platform?
Scalable Data Lake
Gain fast access to one year of hot data for investigations, threat hunting, and response.
Learn More
Threat Content-as-a-Service
Unlock broad threat coverage through continuously curated and delivered threat content that reduces false positives.
Learn More
Frictionless Experience
Provides reduced noise, an intuitive user interface, and targeted threat intelligence that frees analysts from the tedious task of manual log analysis and endless alert triage, allowing them to focus on high-level investigations and strategic decision-making.
Learn More
Cybersecurity Mesh
Seamlessly and agnostically integrate any security tools, clouds, and data lakes. It’s flexible by design to allow organizations to maximize their security investments.
Learn More
AI-Reinforced Platform
Our AI-Reinforced Platform leverages cutting-edge artificial intelligence to enhance the accuracy and speed of threat detection and response. By integrating AI into our SIEM and SOAR solutions, we provide a robust cybersecurity platform that not only detects threats in real time but also simplifies complex data analysis, allowing your security team to focus on strategic initiatives rather than routine monitoring.
Platform Benefits
Detect
Respond
Integrate
Improve
Detect
Detect Advanced Threats
Securonix Unified Defense SIEM is built with industry-leading analytics at its core to help you reduce false positives and monitor user and entity threats across your enterprise.
Detect Insider Threats:
Employ sophisticated algorithms and real-time monitoring to quickly identify subtle indicators of insider threats.
Pre-Built Threat Content and Analytics:
Achieve fast value and remove complexity with OOTB threat content powered by AI-Reinforced analytics.
Threat Models:
Reduce the volume of alerts using threat models that map to both the MITRE ATT&CK and US-CERT frameworks.
Adaptive Threat Modeling:
Dynamic threat models and automatic threat chaining of violations.
Respond
Respond to Threats Faster
Detect threats faster, reduce dwell times, and mitigate risk by simplifying the way your team investigates and responds.
Built-In SOAR:
An unbounded integration between SIEM and SOAR puts all of your data in one place, allowing you to respond faster.
Incident Management:
Track workflows and investigation steps that are useful for compliance audits and tracing data breaches.
Lighting Fast Search:
Easily access critical details before, during, and after a breach with 365 days of ‘HOT’ searchable data
Integrate
Integrate Seamlessly
Uncover blind spots in your multi-cloud environment and reduce complexity with a flexible, open architecture. With Securonix, you can ingest and view all of your data in a single, collaborative UI.
Connectors:
Gain a complete picture of risk with over 500 connectors that ingest data from across your hybrid infrastructure.
Built-In Cloud Integrations:
Uncover blind spots with API-based integrations with cloud applications, infrastructure, and services.
Cybersecurity Mesh:
Seamlessly and agnostically integrate any security tools, clouds, and data lakes
Improve
Improve SOC Efficiency
Empower your SOC to accomplish more with streamlined detection and response. Leverage automated threat sweeps and workflows so your team can focus their time where it matters most.
AI-Powered Investigations:
Reducing investigation times by an average of 15 minutes per incident with AI-generated concise, context aware summarizations.
Unified Analyst Experience:
Streamline the analyst experience to deliver detection, investigation, and response in a single interface.
Autonomous Threat Sweeper:
Automatically and retroactively hunt for emerging threats based on the latest Threat Labs research.
6x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader
REPORT
Industry Leader for Cloud SIEM
Don’t just take our word for it. Securonix has been named a Leader for the 6th consecutive year in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Security Information and Event Management report.

Mid-sized IT Services Organization
SOC MANAGER
“There are a large amount of pre-packaged use cases and parsers that work out of the box and make the onboarding process of new customers very quick and efficient. The interface is slick and has clearly gone through multiple iterations over the years in order to provide fast investigations and interrogation of events.”
Read Review
Large IT Services Organization
SECURITY MANAGER
“Securonix is not a traditional SIEM solution. It identifies all our cybersecurity threats across cloud, on-premise and edge devices. There is no hassle of managing the SIEM infrastructure. It delivers a quick ROI with a rapid deployment process. Analytics is seamlessly delivered and updated on an ongoing basis so we can focus on threats against our organization.”

VICE PRESIDENT
